despite all three direct methods failing. Selection retains production, native 
stanza/BA and TE concerns; it does not authorize biological repair or establish

Model extraction 
Main and supplement transcriptions verified. Two source-unknown deep-water-hake 
P/B values are separately completed as P/Q×Q/B. Sardine stock BA/B is expanded to 
both stanzas; native accounting remains uncertain. SC rock lobster has conflicting 
Panulirus/Palinurus identities. Diet sums 1.0001 and 1.0002 are preserved. Five 
GS=.35 are source-derived; 40 GS=.2, unknown BA, routing/import/migration and 
detritus EE/BA use accepted defaults. Extraction report | Source and conflicts

Geographic fit 
A. Region covered by study: approximately 8–12%. 
B. Study area covered by region: approximately 50–65%. 
Temporal fit 
Static 1978 source applied across 1950–2019 whole-LME catches; reference 2019 is 
41 years later. Fixed coefficients and composition proxies cannot reconstruct annual 
ecosystem changes or northern Benguela biology. 
Other 
All three accepted direct methods remain FAIL. Sardine native stanza/stock-BA 
interpretation and production imbalance remain unresolved. TE has near-zero Cape 
Gannet/Cormorant efficiencies and a 9.62% PP-balance gap. With Egestion also has 
no negative source SPPR; convergence does not remove input failure. Provisional 
regional arithmetic does not establish model approval. Full matrices and diagnostics
